body.cap: Aram Huvis’ Presentation at CES 2025 Pangyo Lunch Talk | Image by AVING News

body.x: Aram Huvis (CEO Dongsoon Park) participated in the ‘CES 2025 Pangyo Lunch Talk’ held on February 20 at the Gyeonggi Startup Campus in Pangyo Techno Valley. This event, organized by the Gyeonggi Business & Science Accelerator and AVING News, was designed to showcase the innovative technologies of Pangyo-based companies that attended CES 2025, fostering industry trend discussions and global business expansion.

Aram Huvis, a specialist in personalized cosmetics, presented its technological achievements and innovations. The company’s name combines ‘Aram,’ meaning ‘beautiful person,’ and ‘Huvis,’ derived from ‘human vision system,’ reflecting its commitment to personalized skincare solutions.

Aram Huvis develops advanced skin, scalp, and hair diagnostic devices, utilizing AI-driven big data analysis to prescribe personalized scalp care solutions. The company emerged from recognizing that individuals have unique skin characteristics, which conventional cosmetics fail to address. By pioneering the customized cosmetics market, Aram Huvis offers solutions that analyze skin and hair conditions to provide optimized product recommendations.

body.cap: Sanghyun Park, Vice President of Aram Huvis | Image by AVING News

body.x: The company operates within the Healthcare Innovation Park at Bundang Seoul National University Hospital, collaborating with medical professionals to conduct clinical trials on personalized cosmetics. Through this initiative, it has refined its scalp diagnostic algorithms and enhanced credibility. Aram Huvis won the CES Innovation Award 2023 Honoree in the Software & Mobile Apps category for its AI-driven scalp analysis solution. They introduced innovations such as the ‘Ellapiel Tailor,’ a personalized cosmetics manufacturing device, and the ‘ECW Cube,’ a personal scalp diagnostic device.

Having participated in CES 2024 and 2025, Aram Huvis continues to strengthen its position in the global beauty tech industry. The company has engaged in business discussions with L’Oréal, P&G, Dior, and Chanel while exploring new markets in the United States, India, Israel, Portugal, Chile, Mexico, and Colombia. Beyond its B2B operations, Aram Huvis is expanding into the B2C market, enabling consumers to experience personalized skincare solutions firsthand.

Under South Korea’s regulatory sandbox program, the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety recognizes Aram Huvis as authorized to manufacture and sell personalized cosmetics, facilitating its domestic and international market expansion. The company has also demonstrated the efficacy of its customized scalp care products through clinical trials involving 100 patients, ensuring scientifically validated solutions.

Vice President Sanghyun Park stated, “Aram Huvis is dedicated to continuous R&D investment, leading advancements in skin diagnostic technology. While the average R&D investment rate among domestic companies stands at 2.8%, Aram Huvis maintains a significantly higher ratio of 19–20%, driving the development of smart skin analysis solutions.” He added, “Our diagnostic devices are currently used by global cosmetic brands such as L’Oréal, P&G, Amorepacific, LG Household & Health Care, Estée Lauder, and Shiseido, and are supplied to over 70 countries worldwide.”

Pangyo Techno Valley is a global R&D hub that integrates Research (R), People (P), Information (I), and Trade (T) across the IT, BT, CT, NT, and mobility sectors. It is a leading innovation cluster in Gyeonggi-do, established to drive technological innovation, talent development, job creation, and international business competitiveness.

The Gyeonggido Business and Science Accelerator’s Techno Valley Innovation Headquarters has continuously promoted Pangyo Techno Valley’s value by hosting events such as the Pangyo Evening Meet-Up, Pan-Pan Day, and Pangyo Startup Investment Exchange In-Best Pangyo. These initiatives have facilitated networking between Pangyo companies, domestic and international investors, and the media. Similar events are planned for this year to support the growth and global expansion of Pangyo startups through various assistance programs.
